title: Level Up in the Real World
description: A man wakes up to find the world has become a game, and he's the only one with the 'Admin' system.

parts.text: Part 1 of Episode 1: Level Up in the Real World Starts. The story unfolds as the protagonist faces new challenges in the world of Action. Every step leads to a greater mystery.
